chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When a man performs Umrah as a Tamattu' (for Hajj), he has fulfilled the obligation of Umrah.

key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: Performs Umrah al-Tamattu' (performing Umrah first, then Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Does performing Umrah for Hajj fulfill the obligation of Umrah?
ai.summary: In the context of Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from al-istibsar clarifies that the Umrah performed as part of Hajj al-Tamattu' serves as the definitive fulfillment of the Umrah obligation, eliminating the need for a separate Umrah al-Mufradah. This ruling underscores the flexibility within the Shia school regarding the structure of pilgrimage, emphasizing that the ritual acts are satisfied by the specific performance intended for that mode of Hajj.
